ios.desc:
If you're a fan of American college football, this app is for you.

Outrank is the easiest way to check how your favorite teams stack up against the rest. It shows you where your team ranks in 47 different tracked statistics compared to the other 138 FBS teams.

Ever wonder where a team ranks in total offense, team sacks, turnover margin, and red zone defense? This is all simple, glanceable, information for each team instead of needing to hunt for each stat individually.

Want to preview the most intriguing matchups of the week? There's a feature for that, too. From the Compare tab, you can select any two teams and see how they compare with a convenient side-by-side view.

Features:
* Choose from all 138 Division One FBS teams
* Check where they rank in 47 different tracked statistics compared to the other 138 teams
* Find where every team ranks for a given stat
* Compare two teams side-by-side to evaluate matchups
* Set your favorite teams and watch them sync seamlessly between Apple devices
* Widgets (top four & bottom four rankings for any team)

I built Outrank because I needed it. I host a college football podcast and wanted a quick way to find where my favorite teams stacked up, but couldn't find a service that provided it without a lot of pain in the process.

The app is free with no ads. It makes me no money by default. If you enjoy Outrank, I'd love it if you left a tip or subscribed in the app.

A Quick Note on Privacy:
* I collect/store *none* of your data. Literally 0. I have no interest in any of it, so we can put that to bed right now.

This app offers subscriptions to support development for $0.99/year, $2.99/year, $4.99/year, and $9.99/year. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period (and charged to your iTunes account). You can turn off auto-renew/manage subscriptions in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Terms of Use can be found at https://ryantoken.com/terms-of-use and Privacy Policy can be found at https://ryantoken.com/privacy-policy

quotes.text:
I just released a new iOS app that's purpose-built for fans of American college football.

Outrank is the easiest way to check how your favorite FBS teams stack up against the rest. It shows you where your team ranks in 47 different tracked statistics compared to the other 129 FBS teams.

You can also compare the most intriguing matchups of the week, set your favorite teams, and more.

I built Outrank because I needed it. I host a college football podcast and wanted a quick way to find where my teams stacked up, but (surprisingly) couldn't find a service that provided it without a lot of pain in the process. Outrank is a simple solution to that problem.

It’s free with no ads. I’d love it if you checked it out and gave me some feedback! It's built with Swift, SwiftUI, Core Data, CloudKit, and AWS.

Read the blog post: https://www.ryantoken.com/blog/introducing-outrank/

Download here for iOS and iPadOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1588983785
quotes.story_title: New iOS/iPadOS app to track 47 stats for your favorite CFB teams – Outrank
